title: NRC mass-timber room Test 1 — fully encapsulated baseline
jurisdiction: Canada (NRC test facility; no local AHJ or project jurisdiction identified)
code_edition: NBCC 2020 proposed Article 3.1.18.4 EMTC context in report; local adoption is not established

facts.text: Test 1 used a fully encapsulated CLT room with three Type X gypsum-board layers: 15.9 mm base layer and two 12.7 mm layers; all wall and ceiling CLT surfaces were protected.
The report records flashover at 6.4 min and burnout/self-extinguishment at 150 min, with data collection ended at 167 min.
The report describes these as room fire tests without sprinklers and as data supporting development of a technical basis for exposed mass timber in encapsulated mass timber construction.

limitations: One controlled NRC test series, not a building-code approval or project-specific design assessment.
